The '''Aratech Military Speeder Bike Prototype''' was a craft used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The craft's agility and acceleration was superior to that of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. Its armaments included a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launcher]]. The Rebels used the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] for [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Chrono">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Proto_speeder_bike.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The speeder bike toy]]
The Aratech Military Speeder Bike Prototype was originally a piece of concept art by [[Joe Johnston]] for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Sketchbook">''[[Return of the Jedi Sketchbook]]''</ref> Concept art of the vehicle appeared in the [[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] where it was referred to as a model from the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].<ref name="SWSB2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

It was later turned into a vehicle by [[Hasbro]] as part of its Expanded Universe line of toys in [[1998]], where it was also referred to as simply "Prototype Speeder Bike," where it was said to be built by Aratech. It included an exclusive Rebel speeder bike pilot action figure.<ref name="Hasbro" /> The speeder bike made a live action appearance in a commercial for various Expanded Universe vehicles, which portrayed the bike and its pilot on Endor being pursued by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="Commercial">{{YouTube|video=KIiBo5xqGVI|text=Star Wars - The Power Of The Force: Expanded Universe Vehicles Commercial|channel=UCZEKn0kEyhbIz1NIMtjowMg|name=Star Wars Comercials}}</ref>

The short comic story "[[Sand Blasted]]" from [[Star Wars Tales 4|''Star Wars Tales'' 4]] includes a "swoop" piloted by [[Spiker]] that matches the design and colors of this speeder bike.<ref name="Sand Blasted">{{Tales|4|Sand Blasted}}</ref>
